tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhi bsnyen bya tshul dang gong ma'i gsung gsal bar bshad pa don gnyer can kun dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo'i mchog gyur dang*// dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// de nyid snying nye'i gzhi'am rgyu yi phyir// gzhi bsnyen bya tshul rgyud gsal kun dga' 'bri// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhi bsnyen bya tshul/ rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung gsal bar byed pa don gnyer can kun dga' bar byed pa 'di la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhi bdag gdug pa can dang*/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i nyer 'tshe med pa bla ma gong ma'i sgrub gnas byin rlabs can la sogs pa/ dben zhing yid dang mthun par khyad par mtshams ma grol gyi bar du 'pho bskyas mi dgos pa'i gnas khang phyag dar byas/ bde na rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa dang*/ zhal sprod kyi tshul du rje btsun ma'i bris 'bur sogs bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du 'di nyid kyi gtor ma zlum po sku bag can mtheb kyus bskor ba rgyan ldan/ gzhan yang bde kye gur zhal/ 'di nyid kyi sgos kyi srung ma dur bdag sogs kyi gtor bsngo byed na de dag kyang phyag len bzhin bshams pa'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ gtor kha gso ba'i mtheb kyu/ rang gi mdun nam g.yas g.yon gang bder rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ me tog 'thor snod/ mtshams ma grol bar bsgul skyod mi dgos pa'i sar dri bzang gis byugs sa dkar pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa bris pa'i khar nas sam 'bras cung zad gtor/ de'i steng stan nang tshangs can 'bol lta bu legs par bzos/ mtshams g.yog kyang 'di ma khom na 'dis byed bsam pa dang*/ lha rje sogs dang*/ bsnyen pa ma grol bar gyi chas ka 'di nas len snyam pa dang*/

dgon sde sogs kyi dkor skal len dgos byung tshe de rnams kyang dmigs khongs su bcug len mi dgos na rab yin gsung des mtshon pa'i phyogs kyi yi ge sogs kyang nang du mi len/ nang nas yi ge dang chas kyi rigs phyir mi gtong*/ cis kyang stabs kyis mi khyud pa'i gtong len dgos na mtshams kyi gdan thog de nas mi bya bar gzhan zhig nas byas pas mtshams ral ba sogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i gnad yin pas thog mar bcad rgya de ha cang dam grags pa ma yin pa rgya che sems byas/ don thob gang dam bya ba yin gsung*/ mtshams ma grol bar legs nyes gang du sogs rung*/ lab lob sogs byung kyang them pa mi 'bud pa'i zhe dam dang rtag tshugs bzung*/ chos dang 'jig rten stabs su mi 'grub/ khyad par bsnyen pa dang gzhan gyi ngo bsrung phyogs gcig mi 'grub pas/ lha 'dre mi gsum dgrar ldang kyang 'jig tu mi snyam pa'i sbad kham gcig ci nas kyang gal che gsungs pas de ltar du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni/ rang nyid khrid yig las bshad pa ltar smin byed rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang rung sngon du song nas/ 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs grol byed khrid rnams legs par nos shing thun gnyis la nyung mtha' byas pa'i chag med kyi rgyud dang ldan pas gegs sel bogs 'don sogs dge sbyor la chig rgya 'phel bar byas te/ sngar bshad pa'i gnas sogs mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pas bsnyen pa byas na dngos grub myur du thob par gsungs pa yin te/ dpung bzang las/ sgrub pa gang zhig rang gi yon tan rdzogs// brtson 'grus mchog dang yan lag ldan pa dang*// gzhan gyi bsnyen pa dag la phrag dog med// 'dod la ma chags lus kyi nyon mongs bzod// gug skyed klad dkor tsheg tshang zur phyin la// gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' brtan pa yis// gnas su bzlas na yid 'ong dngos grub thob// ces gsungs so// sa chen gyi lha brgyad bsgrub lugs kyi yi ge las/

sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i dus su/ dang por phyi mtshams bcad de 'gro 'dug bsdams/ nang mtshams bcad de phyogs bzhir tho bzhi btsugs te rgyal po chen po bzhir mos te mchod pa bya/ a kā ros gtor ma phul ba bdag gi nang gi bar chad dang*/ phyi'i bgegs kyi bar chad srungs shig ces brjod la/ bsrung ba gzhol/ de'i tshe shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bklag pa'i dbu gzugs/ rtog pa chen po 'don/ gzhan med na rang gi sdud pa bklags te smon lam 'grub pa'i stobs yin pas so// rang ngam gzhan gyis cha gsum btang*/ zhes gsungs pas/ de'i don rnams bsnyen bsgrub la 'jug dus su nges par bya dgos zhes rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi yang yang gsungs pas de'i tshul ni mar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba na bya zhing*/ yar ngo'i gza' skar bzang ba la grol ba phyag len du 'dug pas de'i snga dro bshams rnams grub par byas/ dgong thun gong du grogs dam tshig pa dang bcas cha gsum btang*/ bgegs gtor phyir dor ba'i tshe/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam/ bden pa bdar bas de dag gi sku las khro bo dang khro mo me dpung mtshon cha'i char chen po dus gcig tu babs/ gtor ma sbyin pas mi 'gro bar gnod par sems pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par/ yungs kar re re bzhin sprul pa'i pho nya srin po khros pa lta bu me 'bar bzhin pa dang bcas pa grangs med par gyur pa de dag gis bgegs rnams rgyangs ring du bskrad dum bur gtubs/ mes bsregs/ rdul phran tsam yang ma lus par tshar bcad/ chos nyid du thim song snyam du bsam la/ gnas khang dang rten rdzas rnams la bla ma'i ljags thun yod na rab/ med na rang gi sngags mang du btab pa'i yungs kar gyis brab/ ljags gul sogs kyis bdug

rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol/ ngag tu sum bha dang*/ na maḥs man+ta nas ka ra ya swā hā'i bar brjod/ sher snying bzlog pa dang bcas bya/ de nas sgo'i phyi rol g.yas g.yon du tho brtan par brtsigs/ sa dkar gyis bran/ bskyed chog byas te brtan bzhugs kyi me tog gtor/ de nas sngar bshams pa'i rten la rje btsun grags pa'i dgongs pa ltar kha nub tu phyogs pas thun bzhir bya zhing*/ dgong srod tho rangs snga thun te bzhi las/ 'char nub gnyis dang*/ gung gnyis ting nge 'dzin 'jig pa'i dus yin pas/ de dag la thun mtshams khengs nges pa bya/ de yang mtshams la bzhugs ma thag nas ngo mi mtshan ngo mi shes pa lta bu'i ba tshub rta tshub de/ 'phral 'gyur 'dog rnam po cig yong na'ang*/ ji zhig nas khams dub nas ji lhod la sogs rim gyis bgegs dang nad 'jug pa yin pas/ thog ma nas khog grims la sos dal yang ha cang 'jur 'jur du ma song ba bya/ bar du sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu bsgril nas 'jur ma btab ste nyams su blangs/ mjug na mar yang had de bzhag pa lta bu'i ma yin par je yang je lhod la btang ste dge sbyor nas 'dra zhig byas na gegs chung la khe che ba yin pas de lta bu'i tshul du bya/ de yang dus 'di tsam la 'grub par bya snyam pa'i tur tur bo ma yin par ji tsam 'gor kyang legs snyam pa'i dga' spro dang ldan pas/ thog mar rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ rang la sku drin che ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod ci nus dang*/ dngos gzhi skyabs 'gro nas bzung*/ thun bsdu ba'i bar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i lugs 'di la tshad mar brgyud pas de'i sgrub thabs ltar nyams su blangs/ sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsum zhag grangs rang rang gi blo dang bstun pa bya/ yang dngos gzhi lam du 'gro mi 'gro/ sngon 'gro gnad du bsnun mi bsnun la rag las gsungs pas las slar ma song ba bya'o// de nas bdag lhar bskyed pa nas lus dkyil gsal 'debs yo ga shud+dho3'i bar shar sgom du nyams su blangs/

de nas spyir bzlas dmigs ni/ dpung bzang gi rgyud las/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher mi dbyung ha cang chung ba'ang min// smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du g.yengs bzhin min// gug skyed klad kor tshig rnams nyams par min// ji ltar chu klung nyin mtshan rtag tu ni// rgyun mi 'chad pa 'bab par 'gyur ba ltar// de bzhin phyag bcas bzlas dang brtul zhugs kyis// bsod nams lus can la ni 'phel bar 'gyur// le lor 'dod chags mi dger ldan pa'i sems// gang dang gang du g.yo zhing rgyu ba dang*// de dang de nas myur du bzlog nas ni// gsang sngags yi ge mchog 'di legs par sbyar// sna rtser blta zhing lha mor rtog pa spangs// zhes gsungs pas/ bzlas pa'i rkyen yang mi dge ba dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi rnam rtog gi dbang du ma song bar las bzhi gang la gtso bor bya ba/ de nyid kyi bzlas dmigs la bsgrims te bzla dgos pa yin/ khyad par 'di nyid kyi bzlas dmigs ni/ lus dkyil zhal yod pa'i dbang du byas te/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsam pa'i snying gar lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po la sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor ba gsal btab/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad mer gyis gang bas tshe rabs 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib ngan song du skye 'gyur gyi las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad shwa sbud chen po'i sne la sbur mi chags pa'am/ nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs song ba bzhin du de dag sangs kyis dag lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du byas/ yang snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas phyir 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas de dag gi nad gdon sogs sngar bzhin sbyangs/

de thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod 'od du zhu/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa dang lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas sib sib thim pas rang nyid rje btsun ma sngar bas kyang je gsal byin rlabs je cher gyur bar mos nas/ rang gi sngags bzla ba bzhin/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can lus kyi srin bu tshun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur gsal bas sngags kyi sgra di ri ri 'dren par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma bzlas pa'i skyon brgyad sogs dang bral bar bzlas sam/ gtso cher dmigs pa de nyid sbyang yang de sngar ltar 'od zer 'phros pa'i sne la mchod yon sogs nyer mchod phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga sogs spros te phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems la sogs mchod pas mchod/ bstod pas mnyes par byas/ de dag gi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad 'od kyi rnam par spyan drangs lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas thim pas de thams cad kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rang rgyud la zhugs pas de dag gi sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur song snyam pa'i ngang nas 'dzin pa ma zhugs par sngags bzla/ des kyang rnam rtog 'phro ba dang sems dub pa sogs byung na rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal legs par btab/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa de nyid la dmigs pa gtad de 'dzin med du bzla/ res 'ga' sngags kyi sgra grags stong skye ba med pa la sems gtad/ sgra de gang nas 'ong*/ gang du 'gro/ gang na gnas/ sems kyis brtags te de'i ngang la bzla/ res spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar la sems gtad de bzla/ mdor na sems rgya yan 'og 'gyu rgya 'byams/ mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi dbang du skad cig kyang ma song bar gzhan phan byang sems 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba'i sems sogs kyi kun nas bslangs te bzla bar byas te/

rgyud las/ gzhan la mi 'phro'i tshul gyis ni// de lta'i tshul la bzlas pa bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub dag /yun ring dus su 'bad byas kyang*// sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni// de nyid rig pas don med gsungs// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas na bzlas dmigs gal che'o// bzlas pa'i sgang la ja thug bzhes kyang*/ skyabs 'gro nas shis brjod kyi bar ngag dam par bcad/ gzhan la brda byed dgos byung yang sam ṭa lta bu la bris nas bya'o// bzlas pa'i grangs ni gzhi bsnyen zhes sngags 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pa phal cher 'khrul gzhi 'byung bar snang yang*/ de'i don ni 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gur mgon gyi nang khrid las/ sngar bsnyen pa ma byas pa zhig gis thog mar byed pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ mgon po nye bar byed pa'i gzhi bcas pa'am/ rgyu yin pas na gzhi'i bsnyen pa zhes gsungs pas rtogs dgos so// spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam gyi mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs las/ bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum mas g.yon du bskor ba'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes ci nus bzlas so// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum bya'o// gsung na yang sum 'bum/ de'i bzhi 'gyur bzla bar rigs te/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la// bzlas brjod sum 'gyur bya bar bshad// ces dang*/ rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur du ni bzlas// zhes pa las legs grub kyi gsal kha ma byung*/ kho bos bka' 'gyur lan lnga bklags/ dpe mi 'dra ba gsum la zhib 'jug byas par rgyud gzhan la mi snang*/ legs grub las/

mkhas pas gsang sngags yi ge rnams// bco lnga man chad grangs rnams la// spyir ni yi ge du yod pa// de snyed 'bum phrag bzlas brjod bya// yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la// bzlas brjod sum 'bum bya bar bshad// ces pa phyogs gcig par 'dug pas/ spru lung pa'i de dang dgongs pa mthun par 'dug pas/ 'di yi gzhi bsnyen la 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dgos pa lung de dag gis legs par grub bo// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i gur mgon brag rdzong ma'i khrid yid las/ legs grub kyi rgyud las/ yi ge bco lnga man chad la// mkhas pas yi ge 'bum gyi grangs// yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la// 'bum phrag bzhi yi grangs kyis so// zhes 'byung ba ni/ bris nor rgyun 'byams yin nges su 'dug pas phyin chad col gtam mi bya'o// de dag gi skabs su/ sems bying ba gnyid bro pa sogs byung na gos srab pa dang sngags sgra cung zad mtho bar rig pa hur bskyed nas bzla bar bya/ skam ja lta bu'i kha mur byed cing bzlas na phan/ sems rgod na gso thub pa dang*/ sems mnan te shub bus bzlas/ mi nus snyam pa'i sgyid lugs byung na/ sngon gyi grub thob gong ma rnams bla ma gong ma'i dka' spyad mdzad tshul la sems blo btang ba dang*/ thun mtshams su las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ston pa'i dpe sgrag dum tsam bya/ yang skabs 'ga' re rig pa dwang ba'i dbang gis sngags 'gro che la dga' spro byung ba/ lce mi bde ba'i dbang gis sngags 'gro chung ba dang sems mi bde ba sogs byung yang dga' sdug mi bya bar 'dzin med du bzhag na bsgom skyon thams cad des bsal ba yin gsung*/ thun mtshams rnams su chag med gzhan byed dgos dang*/ mdo klog pa dang*/ gtor ma sbyin pa dang*/ sāts+tsha gdab pa/ chos 'chad nyan sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya ba yin kyang gtso cher lus kyi babs dang bstun pa yin/ yang skabs su khams mi bde ba dang*/

rmi lam tshub pa sogs ci byung yang skrag dngangs mi bya bar blo lhod kyis btang*/ don med la shi ba grangs med na/ don log tu shi ba de bas kyang mang*/ don chen la shi ba nyin skar tsam yin pas/ da res 'di thog la shi yang shin tu legs snyam pa'i sbad kham bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang srung 'khor nan cher bya/ khams la 'phrod pa'i sman dang*/ nyi ma la byugs pa sogs 'phrod rten gang bab re song ma shor bar byas pas rim gyis bde bar 'gyur bas mtshams bskyur ba dang bzlas brjod 'jog pa stab stab tu byas na je lhod du 'gro bas lta ba'i gdengs yod na legs/ tha na'ang gang yong ba shog dang 'jigs rgyu med snyam pa'i thag chod sbad kham gcig mi dgos ka med yin gsung*/ bsnyen pa tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar skra dang sen mo mi bregs/ gdong dang lag pa mi bkru/ gnas khang la phyag dar mi bya ba rnams kyang myur du 'grub pa'i gnad yin pas sla bcos su ma song ba gal che che gsungs pas de ltar du bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi'i sgo nas thun rer ngag bzlas ji tsam nus pa dang*/ yid bzlas zhar byung rdzogs rim bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa/ 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pas gnad du bsnun/ thun rer rje btsun ma'i gtor bsngo tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung bzhin bya/ shes shing spro na dur bdag sogs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/ gzhi bdag gtor bsngo rnams kyang bya/ ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa byed bzhin pa yin na/ dgong thun gyi mjug tu bya'o// thun thams cad kyi mjug tu mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam sogs bsngo smon ci shes kyi sgo nas/ dge rtsa sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar rab dngos/ 'bring nyams/ tha ma rmi lam du mtshan ma bzang po mthong ba'am/ grangs bsnyen ji skad bshad pa'i 'bum bcu gnyis/

'bru 'bum/ bye bsnyen sogs rdzogs pa'i tshe/ gtang rag gi tshul du mchod gtor rgyas pa gsar du bshams/ rnying pa rnams kyang legs par gsos te mchod gtor rgyas pa/ gtor bsngo/ grub na bskang gso gtor 'bul rnams rgyas par bya'o// de ltar bzlas pa'i nang nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i oṃ gsum ma 'di shin tu phan yon che ste/ bsgrub bya'i yul du gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba bdun cu yod pa bsdu na bye ba bzhir 'dus/ de yang bsdu na stong phrag bzhir 'du/ de bsdu na rnal 'byor ma bzhi sgo mtshams ma brgyad dang bcas par 'du/ de thams cad bsdu na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'di gcig pur 'dus shing*/ sngags kyang oṃ gsum ma brjod pas yul nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gro thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de ltar bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i phan yon yang*/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gtso mo// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// sngags ni snyan gsan 'bebs par brjod// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros bos pa na// thos pa tsam gyis 'ong bar 'gyur// de bzhin skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs// zhes pa dang*/ dpung bzang las/ tshe rabs gzhan du gang dang gang byas pa'i// sdig pa ma lus bzlas brjod byas pas 'byongs// bzlas pas sdig pa ma lus byang gyur nas// dwang ba'i yid kyis dngos grub thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de nas gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad// ces 'byung bas sngags kyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i phyir bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg kyang mtshams khang der grub na legs pas kho bos bris pa 'di nyid kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi yi ge sogs sngags lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pas/ rang gi blo dang bstun nas byas/ phran bus bris pa'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge der ri bong gcal sgrog gi rjes su 'brangs te/ sa skya'i zhal ngo tsho'i bcu cha 'bul lugs bzhin bzhi 'bum gyi bcu cha 'bul tshul zhig bris yod kyang*/ grangs bsnyen tshad rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung de dag gi 'bum bcu gnyis la bya ba mngon sum du grub pas/ bcu cha 'bul tshul de ltar byas na 'gor che bas 'bum bcu gnyis kyi bcu cha 'grub dka' bas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan sogs kyi bshad pa ltar thun re la 'jig rten pa'i me lha gang 'og la rdzas thun re dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha la rdzas rnams nyer gcig sogs phul nas/ zhi ba'i rdzas rnams kyi gtso bo la til 'ba' zhig oṃ gsum mas phul nas 'grub sla bar 'gyur ro// 'dir smras pa/ mi dbang gcal gtam grags pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// bzhi 'bum bcu cha 'bul tshul bris 'di yang*// rang gi nang cha bstan pas sdig sgrib dang*// 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs rnams snying nas bshags// zhes kyang smras so// de ltar gzhi'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas sngon du song nas/ ma rgyud yum skor man chad kyi las tshogs rab 'byams bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin pas gzhan don rgya che bar bya'o// de ltar lhag bsam dag pas bris pa 'di// sngar nas med pa'i legs bshad ma yin mod// rang nyid skyes thob blo gros mi gsal yang*// rgyud dang gong ma'i dgongs don bsnyen nas 'di// dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs yin// mi nyams srid mtha'i bar du khyab gyur cig /de ltar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gzhi bsnyen bya tshul rgyud dang gong ma'i gsung gsal bar bshad pa/ don gnyer can kun dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba 'di yang rang nyid la 'di lta bu zhig byung na snyam pa'i 'dun ma snga mo nas yod pa dang*/

nye char shing mang rab 'byams pa bstan pa bkra shis kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod pa'i snyoms las pa bud+dha dh+wa dzas rang lo bcu phrag dang nyag ma bdun gyi thog mdzes byed ces pa chu yos sa ga zla ba'i dkar phyogs dge bar/ rang gnas mdo sngags pho brang du sug bris su bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni drin can yab sras spyi bor mchod pa'i ban rgan lhun grub kyis gus spro'i sgo nas myur bar bris pa'o// ༈ /

rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sa chog sa lha dgyes pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sbyin sreg gi sa chog ni/ sa phyogs gang du bya ba'i sa der zlum gtor gcig mchod pa dang bcas/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa bshams nas/ rang nyid kyi mdun du me tog nang mchod rdor dril rnams bshams/ mchod pa sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ zhes pa nas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ dhārmā ra ṇi ta sogs/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa dang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ badz+ri muḥbha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis sbyangs/ bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/

oṃ pri thi wi de wi oṃ a kā ro lan gsum/ oṃ pri thi wi de wi oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// spyod pa'i tshul gyis khyad par du// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi dpung*// bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// lan gsum/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lha mnyes pa dang sems can gyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang sgrub par 'tshal na/ sa phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba thob par gyur/ ces bsam zhing ngag tu brjod la/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg oṃ pri thi wi de wi badz+ra muḥ sa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim// zhes mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o// 'di ni bde mchog pa'i sa chog mdor bsdus pa'o// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ sngar gyi lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang*/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub skye ba 'di nyid la thob pa'i phyir/

zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ thab kyi gzhi sa stegs 'thas par thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la dbus nas khru phyed bskor ba ni thab gyi dngos gzhi/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi pa gnyis kyi zlum por bskor ba'i dang po kha khyer te/ de la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ gnyis pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi'i tshad kyi stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i thig btab pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ rdo rje'i rtse nang du bstan pa bri/ zlum bskor nang ma'i steng nas lte ba'i bar gyi srad bu des/ shar gyi tshangs thig nas bzung ste zlum bskor nang ma'i steng du rtags re byas pas/ rtags drug 'byung ba'i steng thig bsnol bar btab pas chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs 'byung ba'i mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du bris/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng thig btab pa'i lte bar nyi gdan la rdo rje dmar po'am/ tshom bu dmar po gang 'os bkod/ pad+ma sna tshogs pad+ma/ chos 'byung dmar po/ gzhi thams cad dkar po/ bcad rnams ci mdzes su bya/ kha khyer steng du bud shing srog chags med pa'i lci ba skam po'am/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i bud shing brtsigs/ de'i nang du 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor zan gyi ting lo che ba zhig bshams/ gnas khang byi dor dang*/ rten dang mchod pa'i yo byad ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs par stan nang tshang can sogs mdun du cog rtse sogs kyi khar rdor dril gyi bar du gzar bu gnyis kha sprad nas ma bral bar bzhag g.yas su ḍā ma ru dang me tog phor pa/ bsang chu'i dung phor 'thor g.yab dang bcas pa g.yon du nang mchod/ cog rtse'i mdun du me yol 'jim pa la dkar zhal byugs pa wam̐ yig bris pa bzhag rang gi g.yas phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar bsreg rdzas yam shing cang dkar la sogs pa gas grum med pa sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad/

mthe bong las mi sbom zhing*/ mthe'u chung las mi phra ba/ rtsa rtse mar ram sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūr+wa/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ ba glang gi sha dum la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa rnams bshams/ rang gi g.yon phyogs su stegs gtsang ma'i khar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma/ bskang ba byed na bskang gtor phyag len ltar bshams/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga tshar gnyis/ thab kyi mthar bkram rgyu'i ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ me sbar ba'i lce lde/ me gso ba'i rtswa skam po rlung g.yab dang bcas pa bsham pa ni sbyor ba'i chos so// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// dang po ni/ dgong mo'i cha la babs pa na/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs/ gos dkar po gyon/ sdig pa zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ag+na ya ho bha ga wan bid+ya rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum gyis srung 'khor gsal btab/ 'og ma kun la'ang sum bha ni 'di dgos so// skyabs 'gro nas bsam mi khyab kyi thun bsdu ba'i bar gyi bdag bskyed tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rgyun khyer ltar nyams su blang*/ de nas nang mchod byin rlabs ni/ sum bhas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod/ nang mchod nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing*/ bsang chu sgrub pa ni/

sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu rdzas rnams kyi bgegs dang ma dag pa sel pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sum bha ni nyer gcig gam bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis ma khyab pa/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar du phyag rgya dang bcas byin gyis rlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradzñā pa ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas de dag gi gnas khang byin gyis rlabs/ gsum pas mchod pa byin gyis rlabs par bsams la/ ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ bsreg rdzas rnams sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las sreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las so so sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo gnyis gshibs chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bcas la oṃ āḥswā hā/

yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hā/ mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ de dag las gzhan pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams sbyangs shing byin gyis rlabs/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ thab la dmigs te/ sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer la gri gug gi phreng ba dang*/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du e las chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis gang bar gyur/ de nas rgyun bzhag gi me las spar ba'i dpal 'bar lag pa gnyis kyis bzung ste/ oṃ gsum ma bzla bzhin pas thab la g.yon nas lan gsum bskor zhing me tshang du bcug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes me gso/ yang sngags de nyid brjod cing mar blugs gzar bud shing la khyab par blug go /de nas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa dngos ni/ sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las me lha dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon pa'i dang pos dbyug gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang tshangs pa'i skud pas mdzes par byas pa/ khri snyan sa la'i pags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar gyi sham thabs can/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha ye shes pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ lag g.yas dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi/ ma hā bhu ta de wa ri ṣi dwi dzaḥs twa ma gri hi two ma hā asmin+san+ni hi to bha wa ag+na ye/ e h+ye hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ ku sha sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /'dis bdag la gegs med par mdzod cig /ma ma shīn+taṃ kurban ye swā hā/ zhes ku sha'i chun po tshan pa brgyad du byas pa phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis bkram/ zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs kha la yang ram̐ bsam la/ gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ oṃ agha ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang ba'i mthar/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/

thab la g.yon skor du bskor zhing me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye a dī bya dī bya a bhi ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bha ha na ye/ bdag gi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bdun tshan gsum gyis byon zan phul nas phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ shab+da rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// skabs 'dir me pra brtags la/ ngan na bsang chu gtor zhing*/ sum bha ni brjod pas bsrung*/ de nas bsregs rdzas 'bul ba ni/ bsreg rdzas kyi snod lag pa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la g.yon pa'i 'og nas bskor zhing*/ mthar mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ yam shing la/ oṃ ag+na ye bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ bdag gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes gsum ka sbrel bas thog mtha' bar gsum mam/ yang na thog mar gcig dang lhag ma rnams la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa

yam shing ye swā hā/ zhes pas rdzas sngags rkyang pas 'bul/ de bzhin du ku sha'i bar gyi rdzas thams cad bdun sogs grangs mnyam par 'bul/ rdzas sngags so so ni/ oṃ ag+na mar ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na til badz+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ bho de zas mchog ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa 'bras ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza so ba ye swā hā/ oṃ ma hā be ga nas ye swā hā/ oṃ mahā ba la sran ma ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri gro ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe dūr+wa swā hā/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ku sha ye swā hā/ oṃ ma da pañtsa a mṛ ta chang āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ba la pañtsa a mṛ ta ba glang gi sha āḥhūm̐/ yang gong bzhin phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes mar blugs gzar gang phul ba'i rkyen gyis/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes brjod pa ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// gsum pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gi nang du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos g.yon skor du bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas yig 'bru rnams la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/

phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs cing 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su lan gsum bskor zhing ngag tu phaiṃ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shad+dho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje ma/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/

dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pas yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de nas oṃ ag+ne'i tshab tu oṃ gsum ma bcug ste/ oṃ ag+ne ye a di bya sogs me lha'i skabs ltar byon zan dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum dbul/ de nas phyi mchod ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes pa nas shab+da'i bar brjod/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs tshar gsum la ḍā dril rol chen dang bcas pa bya/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod dbul/ lag g.yas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stang kas snying kar bzung*/ g.yon pas dril bu sh+lau ka'i mtshams su gsil zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'ang*// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod/ de nas spros pa la dga' na/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi bstod pa ni/ ye shes chen po'i mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum rgyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dang ba'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// chags chen skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i mnga' bdag he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la=

/nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' ba gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde ba'i ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la= /rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la= /gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod ma lus stsol// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang la= /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la= /dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyi don mdzad nas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la= /dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i lam// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spangs brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis= /bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas rab goms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med rdo rje'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis= /de ltar bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye bdag gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i zhes pa nas/

shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā zhes pa'i bar 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar ci rigs dang*/ lhag ma rnams la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ye swā hā/ zhes rdzas sngags rkyang pas 'bul/ de bzhin du ku sha'i bar du rdzas sngags gong bzhin la grangs mnyam par phul nas/ til la oṃ gsum ma'i bcu cha'i grangs gsog cing*/ 'di la bzhi 'bum gyi bcu cha byed na/ nyin bzhi la thun drug tu byas pa'i nyin dang po la cho ga gcig bar pa gnyis la cho ga gnyis gnyis/ bzhi pa la cho ga gcig ste cho ga drug la sngags bdun stong re bzla dgos shing*/ bsreg rdzas rnams brgya dang bcu re 'bul dgos pas dus gcig tu phul na me shi ba sogs skyon 'ong bas/ sngags bdun brgya re song mtshams til phul nas rdzas gzhan rnams bcu gcig re 'bul/ sngags bzla ba lan bcur byas pas thun re la sngags bdun stong re dang*/ khyon sngags bzhi khri nyis stong 'gro/ 'di rang gi myong bas grub pas cho ga yang ci 'tsham pa zhig yong gi 'dug yang 'bru gsum sogs kyi bcu cha byed na gong gi rdzas sngags rigs 'gres nus na dang*/ ma nus na thun re la bsreg rdzas rnams nyer gcig sogs ci nus phul nas/ til nyungs gang rigs la oṃ gsum ma'i grangs ci 'gro bsags pas yong zhes bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung las thos pa lags/ lha sngags dngos gzhi'i bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i dmigs pa ni/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar phul bar bsam zhing*/ de nas yam shing me 'bar ba'i dkyil du/ mar dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zas mchog rnams zhal du/ ku sha dang dūr+wa'i myu gu dbu'i gtsug tor la/ 'bras sogs gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu phul bar bsam/ de yang nam mkha'i khams thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dbu byas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs kyis gang ba sku mdog dkar po phyag na ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas bdag la dbang bskur zhing sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag nas/

lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du byas byung snyam pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma yengs par byas shing*/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas bdag dang bsgrub bya la phog pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ yang gzhan don du byed na mdun bskyed kyi mdun du pad zla'i gdan la bsgrub bya gang yin pa de gos sogs dkar por gsal ba'i lus la mdun bskyed kyi 'od zer spro bsdus sdig sgrib sbyangs par bsam mo// mthar thun bsdu ba na gshegs skyems sngar ltar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum phul/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ de nas sngar chos kyi rgyal po'i gtor chog rgyas pa bskang gso dang sbrel bar byed na spyi btab kyi/ bkra shis deng 'dir stsol gyi rjes su 'dod don gsol btab byed/ bskang ba mi byed na gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang 'brel bar byed na/ thun snga ma rnams la de yis sangs rgyas rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig rjes su byed/ grol ba'i thun la spyi bstab kyi gtor ma rnams phul/ gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir stsol gyi rjes su byed/ rgyas pa'i skabs rnal 'byor ma'i gtor bsngo bde mchog mjug tu byed/ yang rje btsun ma'i gtor bsngo rkyang pa las mi byed na spyi bstab mi dgos/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod pa/ bsngo smon dang bcas pa'i rjes su/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/

ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs dang*/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po sogs nas badz+ra muḥ'i bar gyi gtor chog rgyas pa ltar las mdun bskyed dang gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs/ zhes pa 'don pa bsgyur/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thal ba cung zad blangs la gnas gsum du byugs cing*/ dam tshig pa bdag la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ sogs go cha'i lha sngags rkyang pa tshar gsum brjod cing gsal btab pa ni 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ni/ yang mar blugs gzar gang dbul zhing*/ oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las rang gzugs su byon par gyur/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams gong ltar ci 'byor phul/ gshegs skyems mar phul nas sngar bzhin mchod bstod/ gtor ma la/ oṃ ag+na ye mthar na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa ni/ me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar phrin las bcol/ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ oṃ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyis bzhud kyi byin za khyod// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ thal ba sngar bzhin blangs la/ dam tshig pa rang la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrung*/ yang go cha'i sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang 'brel na/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' sogs dang*/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam ces bya ba ni/

mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// srid zhi'i mig 'phrul cir yang snang ba las// deng 'dir mkha' spyod dpal mo yid 'ong ma// snying nas 'dud do 'khyud pa'i brtse bas skyongs// 'og min zhing na lhan skyes rgyal yum ma// nyer bzhi'i dbus na zhing skyes ḍā ki ma// nor 'dzin khyab pa'i karma mu dra ma// rnal 'byor bdag gi skyabs mchog rje btsun ma// khyed ni sems nyid stong pa'i rang rtsal te// rdo rje'i grong na e yig bam̐ gyi dngos// sgyu ma'i gling na 'jigs rung srin mo dang*// 'dzum dkar g.yo ba lang tsho gsar pa ston// bdag gis ji ltar btsal kyang 'phags ma khyod// bden par grub kyang nges pa ma snyed nas// spros pas dub pa'i sems kyi gzhon du de// brjod bral nags kyi khang bur ngal gso brten// e ma da ni ḍā ki'i dbyings nas bzhengs// he ru ka dpal rgyud kyi rgyal po las// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye ba'i snying po mchog /bklag pas 'grub ces gsungs pa'i bden pas skyongs// au ḍī bi sha bas mtha'i nags khrod du// grub pa'i dbang po rdo rje dril bu pa// 'khyud dang tsum+bha'i bde bas rjes skyong ltar// mkha' sbyor mchog gis rol zhing bdag kyang skyongs// gaṅgā'i gling du rje btsun ku sā li// mngon sum nam mkha'i dbyings su khrid pa dang*// dpal ldan nā ro ta pas rjes bzung ltar// bdag kyang mkha' spyod dga' ma'i grong du khrid// rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gi thugs rje dang*// rgyud chen gsang mtha'i myur lam zab khyad dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthus// mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'dzum zhal myur mthong shog /ces sogs bsngo smon dang*/ de nas mtshungs med bla ma sogs dkyus ma dang*/ 'di ga'i dgos kyi shis brjod byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa ni/ phun tshogs bde legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog

/rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang sdud mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes brjid pa'i sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrogs pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i= /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yis// sna tshogs thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin sgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi= /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams ldan zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyang bskum tshul// sngags skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi= /gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog /zhes sogs mthar rgyas su bya'o// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba 'di ni rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i dga' ston gzhir bzhag der tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nye lam sogs nas kha 'gengs par gsungs pa rnams kha bskang*/ gzhal yas khang thab bskyed sogs kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seṅge/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ bdag chen kun dga' bsod nams pa'i sbyin sreg gi yi ge rnams las legs cha bsdus pa ma gtogs rang bzo'i bslad med par las dang po pa rnams khyer bde ba'i phyir gzhan phan gyi bsam pas bris so// 'dir sa chog dang sbyin sreg grol nyin tshogs 'khor mdzad pas de'i yi ge zur du dgod yod do// 'dir smras pa// deng sang tshar lugs 'khrul med 'di yin zhes// zhal yangs mdzad pa'i yi ge mang na yang*// rgyu skar snang ba du ma'i 'jug ring zhing*/

/jo nang ba sogs gzhan gyi tshar lugs 'dra mo'i rang gi 'dod pa 'dres pa'i skyon sna tshogs bsres tshar lugs 'khrul med rnams tshong dus kyi 'o ma bzhin bslad sna tshogs mthong*/ ste yid brtan mi bya'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i lugs srol gyi// cho ga'i sbyin sreg gi bzhin bzang ste tshar lugs 'khrul med legs par rtogs par 'dod na// 'char byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga gsal po dngul dkar gyi me long ste mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i them skas 'di gzigs dang*// ma 'dres pa'i jo nang pa sogs gzugs sbyin sreg gi cho ga brnyan mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i them skas gsal por 'di yis mthong*/ bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ gsum ldan pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nye ba'i snying po la// yi ge'i grangs so gnyis kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag so gnyis dang*// kha bskang bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas bzlas gyur na// rjes su skye ba 'dir skal pa med kyang bar dor 'dzin pa dga' mas zhal gyis bzhes/ par 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar las thos so// zhes pa 'di ni rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa bud+dha dh+wa dzas me phag zla tshes sman chur ngag 'don rkyang pa zhig bris pa las/ de nyid la bsham dang dmigs pa sogs kha gtsang zhig bris zhes grogs mchog dam pa ngag dbang lhun grub dang bkra shis lhun grub gnyis sogs kyis yang yang bskul bas rkyen byas slar yang bud+dha dh+wa dzas lcags stag zla tshes la sman chur bris pa'o// 'dis kyang kha'u brag rdzong pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo'i bstan pa rin po che'i phyogs dus gnas skabs su thams cad du dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
